policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: Government of Canada travel guidance expressly records visa-free tourist entry for these ordinary Canadian-passport destinations, subject to their stated durations.
conditions: BA: tourist stays up to 90 days; registration is required after three or more days. VG: tourist stays up to six months, with an ED card, arrival/departure taxes and requested onward-ticket, funds and accommodation evidence.
TN: tourist stays up to 90 days. UA: tourist stays up to 90 days in 180 days; work is separate and dual-national Ukrainian entry rules may apply. PA: tourist stays up to 180 days.

This records only a Regular Canadian passport short-visitor baseline. It excludes diplomatic, official, emergency and temporary documents, residence, work, study, transit, health, carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Comoros tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance expressly permits a Canadian tourist visa on arrival at Moroni airport and other points of entry.
conditions: Available for tourist travel at Prince Said Ibrahim International Airport in Moroni or other points of entry; the stated fee can be paid in euros.
An onward or return ticket is required. Business, student, residence, special-document and final-admission cases are not normalized.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Iraq electronic visitor-visa route
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance expressly identifies an online Iraqi visa route before travel for Canadian passport holders.
conditions: Canadian passport holders travelling by air via Baghdad may obtain the required federal Iraqi visa online before travel; an embassy or consulate route is also stated.

Kurdistan requires a separate electronic visa and a distinct Iraqi visa is needed to travel beyond it. This does not classify residence, work, study, transit, special documents, registration, security or final admission.

application.label: Iraqi Ministry of Interior electronic visa portal
steps: Confirm whether travel is to federal Iraq or the Kurdistan Region and use the appropriate official electronic route.
Apply online before departure using the Regular Canadian passport to be used for travel.
Comply with any regional registration and final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic visitor-visa route
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance expressly requires an e-visa through the Government of South Sudan website before departure.
conditions: Obtain the e-visa online through the Government of South Sudan website before departure.
This does not classify transit, work, study, residence, special documents, registration, health, security or final-admission requirements.

application.label: Government of South Sudan e-Visa portal
steps: Apply online before departure using the Regular Canadian passport to be used for travel.
Carry the issued travel authorization as required by the portal and carrier.
Comply with destination registration, health, security and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: named advance mission visa routes
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance describes a pre-departure mission-issued visa route for each listed destination, rather than an electronic or border-issued visa.
conditions: LY: visas are issued only to residents in the application country, after in-person embassy or consulate submission; mail applications are not accepted.

SY: non-Arab nationals cannot obtain a visa at border points and must obtain it from a Syrian embassy or consulate before departure. Israeli and certain Egyptian/Jordanian-border stamps can result in denial.
This does not classify journalist special permission, business, work, study, residence, transit, special documents, operational restrictions or final admission.
